turns_text: [SEG0001] person_1 (NURSE): Come through, I'll take your blood pressure and weight before doctor calls you. Sleeve up a little, please.

[SEG0002] person_2 (PATIENT): Yes sister, yesterday only the boy at the medical shop checked me, and these cuffs always squeeze too much, my arm becomes red, but okay, do it, you have to write it in the book I know.
[SEG0003] person_1 (NURSE): Today's reading is 152 over 88, pulse 76. Weight is 83 kilograms. You can go in, he is free.
[SEG0004] person_2 (PATIENT): 83 I will accept, sister, the wedding sweets have done this. Kindly don't make the cuff so tight next time, it is paining even now.
[SEG0005] person_3 (DOCTOR): Sorry, one minute, this screen has frozen on the old letter. Yes, sit. Tell me, what is the trouble?

[SEG0006] person_2 (PATIENT): Doctor, my right knee is paining very much. Coming down the stairs it is like a knife, the temple stairs especially, and at night also it is paining so I cannot sleep properly.
[SEG0007] person_3 (DOCTOR): Right knee, stairs, night. Say the side again, I clicked the wrong box.

[SEG0008] person_2 (PATIENT): Right knee only, doctor. Left knee is okay, no problem there, God's grace. At night the pain wakes me and I sit up and rub it, and for the stairs I hold the rail and come one step at a time.
[SEG0009] person_3 (DOCTOR): How long has this been going on?

[SEG0010] person_2 (PATIENT): Actually what happened, my grandson's wedding was there, a big function, I stood for all the photos near the pandal, the hall stairs were very steep with no proper rail, and relatives had come from Pune so I could not sit, my son was telling papa sit but what to do.
[SEG0011] person_3 (DOCTOR): Mm, the page just refreshed. How long, in weeks or months? I did not get that.
[SEG0012] person_2 (PATIENT): Two months, doctor. It started after that wedding only. Before the wedding I was climbing the temple steps with no issue at all.
[SEG0013] person_1 (NURSE): Doctor, the referral in the file says knee pain for six months. I am just reading what is typed.
[SEG0014] person_2 (PATIENT): Six months? No no, sister, that is wrong. My son filled the form in a hurry, he put six by mistake. It is two months, I am very sure of that.
[SEG0015] person_3 (DOCTOR): Alright, I will put roughly two to six months and not fight the computer. Is coming down worse than going up?
[SEG0016] person_2 (PATIENT): Coming down is the worst, doctor. Going up I manage slowly. On the flat road in the colony I walk every morning, that is okay, but one step down and it is finished.
[SEG0017] person_3 (DOCTOR): Any swelling in that knee?

[SEG0018] person_2 (PATIENT): See, doctor, I am already applying the gel, Voveran gel, the chemist uncle near the bus stop gave the yellow tube, I put it morning and night and I rub for a full five minutes, my wife usually rubs but she is at my daughter's place this whole month.
[SEG0019] person_3 (DOCTOR): The gel we will note. Is the knee swollen, yes or no? I asked that.
[SEG0020] person_2 (PATIENT): No doctor, swelling is not there. It is not looking big, and no redness also. Only the pain.
[SEG0021] person_3 (DOCTOR): Does it lock, or give way under you?
[SEG0022] person_2 (PATIENT): No, it is not locking, and it does not give way. I am not falling. There is a little stiffness in the morning, maybe ten minutes, then it loosens.
[SEG0023] person_3 (DOCTOR): What are you actually taking for the pain? Slowly, I am typing.

[SEG0024] person_2 (PATIENT): The Voveran gel morning and night on the right knee, as I said. And sometimes, not daily, I take the Voveran tablet from the medical shop, by mouth, 50 mg, one tablet, when the pain is too much, two or three times in a week.
[SEG0025] person_3 (DOCTOR): Sorry, a pop-up covered your dose. The tablet again?
[SEG0026] person_2 (PATIENT): 50 mg, by mouth, one tablet, two or three times in a week. Not every day, doctor. The gel is separate, morning and night, that one I don't miss.
[SEG0027] person_3 (DOCTOR): Any stomach problem with those tablets? Acidity, pain in the stomach?
[SEG0028] person_2 (PATIENT): No no, stomach is perfectly alright. No acidity, no pain in the stomach, nothing like that. I always eat food and then only I take the tablet.
[SEG0029] person_3 (DOCTOR): Any other regular medicines, for sugar or for pressure? The list on screen is blank.

[SEG0030] person_2 (PATIENT): Yes, I have diabetes since ten years, and BP is also there. I take my sugar tablets, Glycomet 500 mg, by mouth, morning and night after food. For the leg swelling I take the water tablet in the morning, the small white one, the village doctor started that.
[SEG0031] person_3 (DOCTOR): The water tablet, what name is on the strip? I cannot see a match here.
[SEG0032] person_2 (PATIENT): The name I don't remember, doctor, truly. It is the water tablet only, small and white, I take one every morning by mouth. That much I know, nothing more.
[SEG0033] person_1 (NURSE): In the file it is written furosemide 40 mg, once in the morning. That should be the water tablet.
[SEG0034] person_2 (PATIENT): Forty? No sister, I don't take 40. I break it and I take 20 mg only, half the tablet, every morning. The village doctor was very strict, half, not the full one.
[SEG0035] person_3 (DOCTOR): Diabetes for ten years and BP, both noted. I am not guessing the water-tablet dose, the two numbers don't match. Any allergy to medicines?
[SEG0036] person_2 (PATIENT): No doctor, no allergy to any medicine. Even penicillin I have taken in the past, no reaction, no rash, nothing.

[SEG0037] person_3 (DOCTOR): Let me feel the knee. One second, this chair wheel is stuck. Inner side of the right knee is tender, there is crepitus when you bend, and I don't feel any fluid in the joint.

[SEG0038] person_2 (PATIENT): Bending for prayers is the difficult part, doctor. I cannot squat at the temple, I sit on a plastic chair, and the priests look at me as if I have become modern. Flat walking is still possible.
[SEG0039] person_3 (DOCTOR): Weight today is 83 kilograms. That load sits on this knee. If you bring down even three or four kilos it will help the pain.

[SEG0040] person_2 (PATIENT): I know, I know. After I retired from the railways I sit more, and at the wedding I ate so many laddus, and daily rice is two times, my daughter-in-law serves a full plate. Morning colony walk is the only exercise I am doing.
[SEG0041] person_3 (DOCTOR): You told me the stomach is fine. After the tablet at night, is there anything else? Say it once more, I had opened the wrong tab.

[SEG0042] person_2 (PATIENT): Actually, doctor, I should not have said it is fine. After I take that Voveran tablet I get heartburn, a burning in the chest, most times I take it. I drink a little cold milk and I lie on the left side, and then only it settles slowly.

[SEG0043] person_2 (PATIENT): It is not every night, only on the nights I swallow that pharmacy tablet. The gel never does this. I have even reduced the spicy pickle, but the burning is from the tablet, I am sure of that.

[SEG0044] person_3 (DOCTOR): So the heartburn is there with the tablet. I have it now. I think this is wear and tear, osteoarthritis of the right knee. That is a working impression, not a final label, and we have no x-ray today.

[SEG0045] person_2 (PATIENT): My father had the same knee trouble, doctor. At the age of seventy he had the operation in Pune. So when you say wear and tear I get a little frightened, what to tell you.
[SEG0046] person_3 (DOCTOR): I have noted your father. We might send you for physiotherapy, or we might do an injection into the knee. I am not deciding either one today.

[SEG0047] person_2 (PATIENT): Injection I am very scared of. My neighbour took a knee injection and for two days he walked like a wooden stick, and the physio clinic is two buses away, my son is on shift so who will take me, that is the real problem.

[SEG0048] person_3 (DOCTOR): Neither one is booked. Please stop the Voveran tablets from the pharmacy, the heartburn is a reason. Continue the gel morning and night. For the pain, start Crocin, paracetamol, 500 mg by mouth, up to three times a day, with food.

[SEG0049] person_2 (PATIENT): Crocin I know, doctor, the fever tablet, the white one from childhood. So even if the night pain is very bad I should not take the pharmacy Voveran, kindly confirm, and the gel I can keep?
[SEG0050] person_3 (DOCTOR): Yes, stop those pharmacy tablets. Keep the gel. Use the Crocin as I said. Come back in six weeks and we will decide between physio and the injection.

[SEG0051] person_2 (PATIENT): Six weeks is a long gap. The temple stairs are every evening for aarti, I don't like to skip, and the night pain disturbs my son also, we are living in the same house, his room is next to mine.
[SEG0052] person_3 (DOCTOR): If the pain becomes much worse, come earlier. Otherwise I will see you in six weeks. And try to cut the rice and the sweets a little, for this weight.

[SEG0053] person_2 (PATIENT): I will try, doctor. I will tell my daughter-in-law less rice, and the morning walk I will not stop. The gel morning and night I will remember. You are patient even when the computer is misbehaving.
[SEG0054] person_3 (DOCTOR): For the morning stiffness, keep the knee gently moving, don't sit still the whole day. That is all I wanted to say, and the screen has finally saved, thank God.
[SEG0055] person_1 (NURSE): I will print the follow-up slip for six weeks. Furosemide I have left without a dose, because you and the file did not agree.

[SEG0056] person_2 (PATIENT): Yes sister, kindly don't write 40 mg. I am taking 20 mg only, half tablet. If this doctor wants the village doctor's number I can bring it next time, my son has it in the phone.
[SEG0057] person_3 (DOCTOR): No need to ring anyone today. Bring the strip next visit if you remember, otherwise we leave the dose as it is. You can go.

[SEG0058] person_2 (PATIENT): Thank you doctor, thank you sister. I will stop the pharmacy tablet from tonight itself, and Crocin I will buy on the way, the medical shop near the bus stop only, the same uncle.
[SEG0059] person_1 (NURSE): The slip is for six weeks at this clinic. If you come earlier, just tell reception it was for the knee.
[SEG0060] person_3 (DOCTOR): Alright. Mind the stairs till then. I have to reboot this thing now, off you go.

omissions.text: Right knee pain began after standing for long periods at his grandson's wedding; before the wedding he had no trouble climbing temple steps.
On flat ground he can still walk/manage, but stairs are markedly worse and he comes down one step at a time holding the rail.
Initially denied stomach symptoms, but later corrected this: Voveran tablets cause heartburn/burning in the chest most times he takes them; the gel does not.
Negative finding asked and answered: no acidity and no stomach pain were denied when asked about stomach problems with Voveran tablets.
Water tablet dose is recorded incompletely/wrongly: patient specifically said he takes half of a 40 mg furosemide tablet, i.e. 20 mg by mouth every morning, and asked that 40 mg not be written.
Allergy history detail: he specifically reported no medicine allergy and has previously taken penicillin without rash or reaction.
Functional impact: he cannot squat/bend for prayers at the temple and uses a plastic chair; night pain disturbs sleep and also disturbs his son in the next room.
Doctor advised there was no x-ray today when giving the provisional osteoarthritis impression.

There is a real patient concern/disagreement about management: he is scared of a knee injection, citing a neighbour's experience, and physiotherapy access is difficult because the clinic is two bus rides away and his son is on shift.
Doctor explicitly told him not to take the pharmacy Voveran tablet even if night pain is bad, to stop it from tonight, and to continue only the gel plus Crocin.
